statement_blocker: The catalog does not select a finite incidence geometry, its carriers and parameters, a graph construction or graph category, the direction of the relationship, ordered binders, hypotheses, exact conclusion, or boundary cases. Choosing a projective-plane incidence graph, a collinearity graph, a strongly or distance regular graph result, a parameter formula, an extremal result, or a reconstruction theorem would invent or substitute proposition-changing mathematics and may absorb neighboring targets.
target_decision: redirect the catalog relationship-family label to a corrected, independently reviewed, source-selected exact proposition before ordinary statement or proof execution
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix the point, line or block, and graph vertex/edge carriers and universes; the incidence and adjacency representations; finiteness and equality/isomorphism conventions; geometry order, dimension, coordinate field or other parameters; and all typeclass data.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose a geometry-to-graph construction, graph-to-geometry reconstruction, equivalence, parameter identity, regularity or spectrum theorem, girth/diameter result, extremal bound, existence theorem, or classification.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every empty, small-order, repeated-incidence, graph-loop, disconnectedness, coordinatization, polarity, and isomorphism case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: parameter properties of the incidence or Levi graph of a finite projective or affine plane
strong or distance regularity of a point, collinearity, line, polarity, flag, or incidence graph from a selected finite geometry
reconstruction or characterization of a selected incidence geometry from a graph satisfying source-selected local and global axioms
finite-geometry constructions yielding selected extremal, spectral, coloring, expansion, or automorphism results
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty point or line carriers, empty incidence relations, and graph carriers with isolated vertices
orders zero or one, the smallest projective or affine planes, and vacuous incidence axioms
repeated blocks, parallel lines, coincident point or line objects, loops, multiple edges, and directed or colored conventions
finite versus locally finite geometry and finite type versus finite-set representation
Desarguesian versus non-Desarguesian planes, coordinate fields versus division rings, and non-prime-power orders
degenerate polarities, absolute points, disconnected incidence graphs, and whether graph isomorphism reconstructs incidence isomorphism
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-0895 strongly regular graph parameter constraints

a definition or construction presented as a proved structural, parameter, spectral, extremal, or classification theorem
a structure, predicate field, or hypothesis that assumes the desired geometry-to-graph property
generic Configuration, ProjectivePlane, SimpleGraph, incidence-set, matrix, regularity, or cardinality APIs alone
a database lookup, randomized search, solver result, experiment, or unchecked certificate

archive_and_recovery_boundary: Repository Git history plus the integration lane's durable worker snapshot are the intended recovery mechanism after acceptance; this unaccepted worker dossier has no independent archive or release-recovery claim.
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source or target correction, selected geometry, incidence representation, graph construction or category, direction, parameter domain, hypothesis, conclusion, boundary case, neighbor reconciliation, Lean target, toolchain or dependency pin, assurance profile, validator, or any owned artifact change; independent reviewers and master acceptance remain open.
